rdfs:label: Plan
rdfs:comment: An entity describing a plan — a set of intended actions to achieve some goal.
notes: PROV subclass of `urn:solid:Entity`. A Plan is the design or recipe an Activity follows — distinct from the Activity itself (the execution). Attached via `urn:solid:hadPlan` on a `urn:solid:Association` (Activity --qualifiedAssociation--> Association --hadPlan--> Plan); there is no direct Activity→Plan property in PROV.

history.note: Notes: hadPlan hangs off Association, not Activity; seeAlso uses urn:solid:hadPlan.
